result.topic_en: The page notes that the Riemann surface is covered densely, records Fuchs's theorem on linear differential equations in which the coefficients depend on a parameter, and proposes checking whether Eisenstein's theorem on power series of algebraic functions has a converse for power series satisfying linear differential equations.

items.english: See whether Eisenstein's theorem can be reversed in the following way. The theorem states that every power series in z which represents an algebraic function becomes a power series with integer coefficients under the substitution z = Az', where A is a suitable rational integer.
